# Code des tableaux, et des graphiques ainsi que des analyses statistiques.
J'ai utilisée la plage horaire 1990-2023 pour concorder avec les années utilisées par nos journalistes.
```{r}

# --- Packages ---
library(sf); library(dplyr); library(readr); library(purrr)
library(readxl); library(ggplot2); library(tidyr); library(scales)
library(knitr); library(kableExtra)

# --- Paramètres ---
ANNEE_DEBUT <- 1990
ANNEE_FIN   <- 2023
annees_voulues <- as.character(ANNEE_DEBUT:ANNEE_FIN)

# --- Thème & couleurs ---
couleurs_causes <- c("Activité Humaine"="#6BAED6", "Foudre"="#FDAE6B", "Autres Causes"="#C7E9C0")
theme_pub <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color="grey85"),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face="bold"),
        plot.title  = element_text(face="bold", size=15),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size=11, color="grey35"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill="#F8F8F8", color=NA))


# 1) EXTRAIRE TOTAUX ANNUELS DEPUIS LE SHAPEFILE MULTI-ANNÉES

shapefile_path <- "/Users/adjaratousarr/Downloads/NBAC_1972to2024_20250506_shp/NBAC_1972to2024_20250506.shp"
nbac_sf <- st_read(shapefile_path, quiet = TRUE)

col_surface <- intersect(c("ADJ_HA","POLY_HA","AREA_HA","Shape_Area"), names(nbac_sf))[1]


df_total <- nbac_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(year = as.numeric(.data$YEAR),
            total_brule_ha = as.numeric(.data[[col_surface]])) |>
  filter(!is.na(year)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(total_brule_ha = sum(total_brule_ha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(year)

# Sauvegarder le CSV dans le dossier de travail 
csv_total_path <- file.path(getwd(), "NBAC_totaux_annuels_1972_2024.csv")
write_csv(df_total, csv_total_path)

cat("Créé :", csv_total_path, "\n")

# Filtre 1990–2023 + conversion km² pour les graphes
df_total_9023 <- df_total |>
  filter(year >= ANNEE_DEBUT, year <= ANNEE_FIN) |>
  mutate(total_km2 = total_brule_ha / 100)


# 2) FIGURE A — SUPERFICIE TOTALE (1990–2023)

mod <- lm(total_km2 ~ year, data = df_total_9023)

pA <- ggplot(df_total_9023, aes(year, total_km2)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = "Observé"), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = "Observé"), size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = "Tendance linéaire"),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Observé"="#77AADD", "Tendance linéaire"="red"), name=NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(title = "Superficie totale brûlée au Canada (1990–2023)",
       subtitle = paste0("NBAC. Tendance linéaire : ", round(coef(mod)[2], 2), " km²/an"),
       x = "Année", y = "Superficie brûlée (km²)") +
  theme_pub

ggsave("fig_total_annuel_1990_2023.png", pA, width=9, height=4.8, dpi=400)

print(pA)


# 3) FIGURE B — SUPERFICIE PAR CAUSE (1990–2023) + TABLEAU POURCENTAGES

# Fichier Excel (c'est le tableau NBAC par cause & juridiction)
path_xlsx <- "/Users/adjaratousarr/Downloads/Data.xlsx"

donnees_causes <- read_excel(path_xlsx, skip = 2, col_names = FALSE)
colnames(donnees_causes) <- c("jurisdiction","cause","qualification","`1990`:`2023`" = annees_voulues)


donnees_causes <- donnees_causes |>
  tidyr::fill(jurisdiction, cause) |>
  dplyr::filter(!jurisdiction %in% c("Canada","Total","All Agencies"))

# Long format + regroupement des causes
donnees_causes_long <- donnees_causes |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(annees_voulues),
               names_to = "Year", values_to = "Value_ha") |>
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year),
         Value_km2 = as.numeric(Value_ha)/100,
         Cause_Group = case_when(
           cause == "Human activity" ~ "Activité Humaine",
           cause == "Lightning"      ~ "Foudre",
           cause %in% c("Natural cause","Prescribed burn","Unspecified","Reburn") ~ "Autres Causes",
           TRUE ~ "Autres Causes"
         )) |>
  filter(Year >= ANNEE_DEBUT, Year <= ANNEE_FIN, qualification != "e")

# Agrégation année × cause
donnees_causes_agg <- donnees_causes_long |>
  group_by(Year, Cause_Group) |>
  summarise(Total_km2 = sum(Value_km2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Graphique par cause
pB <- ggplot(donnees_causes_agg, aes(Year, Total_km2, fill = Cause_Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="white", linewidth=0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = couleurs_causes) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(title = "Superficie brûlée par groupe de cause (1990–2023)",
       subtitle = "NBAC – Somme de toutes les juridictions | unités : km²",
       x = "Année", y = "Superficie brûlée (km²)", fill = "Cause") +
  theme_pub

ggsave("fig_superficie_par_cause_1990_2023.png", pB, width=9, height=4.8, dpi=400)

print(pB)

# Tableau des pourcentages (1990–2023)
tableau_cause <- donnees_causes_agg |>
  group_by(Cause_Group) |>
  summarise(`Superficie totale (km²)` = sum(Total_km2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop") |>
  mutate(`Part du total (%)` = round(100 * `Superficie totale (km²)` / sum(`Superficie totale (km²)`), 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(`Part du total (%)`))

# Export CSV (pour Word) 
write.csv(tableau_cause, "table_pourcentages_cause_1990_2023.csv", row.names = FALSE)

kable(tableau_cause,
      caption = "Tableau 1 — Répartition de la superficie brûlée par cause (1990–2023)",
      align = c("l","r","r")) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover")) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)


```
